{{2019–20 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball standings}}

The '''2019–20 Washington Huskies men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Washington]] in the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Huskies, led by third-year head coach [[Mike Hopkins (basketball)|Mike Hopkins]], played their home games at [[Hec Edmundson Pavilion|Alaska Airlines Arena at Hec Edmundson Pavilion]] in [[Seattle|Seattle, Washington]] as members of the [[Pac-12 Conference men's basketball|Pac-12 Conference]]. They finished the season 15–17, 5–13 in Pac-12 play to finish in last place. They lost in the first round of the [[2020 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] to [[2019–20 Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team|Arizona]].

==Previous season==
The [[2018–19 Washington Huskies men's basketball team|Huskies]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball rankings|2018–19 season]] 27–9, 15–2 in [[2018–19 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12]] play to finish in first place. Coach Hopkins received back to back Pac-12 Coach of the Year awards. [[Matisse Thybulle]] was named Pac-12 Defender of the Year. [[Jaylen Nowell]] was named Pac-12 Player of the Year.<ref>{{cite news|date=March 11, 2019|title=Pac-12 announces 2018-19 Men's Basketball annual major Quade Green transferred from Kentucky at the end of their Fall quarter in 2018. He was scheduled to be eligible to play with the Huskies starting December 17, 2019 but after a petition to NCAA it was deemed that he is eligible to play for the full 2019–20 season.<ref>{{cite news |first=Percy |last=Allen |date=November 1, 2019 |title=Kentucky transfer Quade Green immediately eligible to join UW Huskies |url=https://www.seattletimes.com/sports/uw-husky-basketball/kentucky-transfer-quade-green-immediately-eligible-to-join-uw-huskies/ |work=[[Seattle Times]] |access-date=November 1, 2019}}</ref>
